title: heterotheca villosa var. ballardii
intro: Heterotheca villosa var. ballardii, commonly known as Ballard's greenthread, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and the relief of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Heterotheca villosa var. ballardii have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
